notes.title: Patch notes 0.1.5
notes.content:
- fixed a bug that prevents a certain item to appear that is necessary to progress

- increased the display duration of the text in the intro 

- player char now casts a shadow

- adjusted UI to not get cropped by different aspect ratios  

- removed teleport trigger in the spiral 

- door opens slightly faster now

- fullscreen is now on by default
